# Assessment Overview

Supplementary assessment documents generated for this report:

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - Two-layer architecture view covering application layers and component relationships.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Declared dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - API endpoints, service contracts, and communication sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, entity diagram, and data boundaries.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, properties, and secrets handling inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Primary business workflows, data flows, and decision logic.
